name: Clio Manage
description: Clio Manage is cloud-based legal practice management software for law firms, covering matter and contact management, calendaring, document management, time tracking and billing, trust and operating account reconciliation, and client communication through secure messaging and a client portal. Clio (Themis Solutions Inc., founded 2008) states its software is used by 400,000+ legal professionals in more than 130 countries, with AI features across the platform branded as Manage AI.
best_for: Law firms of any size that want a single cloud system for matter management, time tracking, trust-compliant billing, and client communication, with an entry-level plan published at a real self-serve starting price.
features: Matter, contact, and document management with unlimited document storage
Calendaring with AI-assisted capture of calendar events and tasks from court documents
Time and expense tracking, with online client payments via card, eCheck, Apple Pay, or Google Pay
Trust and operating account reconciliation built in, without separate bookkeeping software
Manage AI: AI-drafted bills on a set schedule, document-to-calendar-event conversion, and AI-drafted client updates from matter activity
Secure client portal plus two-way text, email, and portal messaging
Custom fields, kanban-style matter stages, and custom roles/permissions on higher tiers
Multi-currency billing and split billing across payers on higher tiers
300+ integrations across calendar, email, accounting, and document storage, plus an open API and Zapier support
Native mobile apps for iOS and Android
pros: The entry Starter plan has a real published self-serve starting price ($49/user) rather than a pure quote wall
Clio reports 400,000+ legal professionals using its software across 130+ countries
States SOC 2 Type II certification, with client data never used to train AI models per its pricing FAQ
cons: Only the entry Starter plan has a published price — Core, Signature, and Elite are all quote-based ("Get pricing")
AI features (Manage AI) and higher-tier capabilities like unlimited custom roles, kanban matter stages, and multi-currency billing require moving up from the Starter plan

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Displayed on Clio's pricing page as "Starting at $49/user" without an explicit monthly/annual billing-period label. Includes matter/contact/document management, time and expense tracking, online client payments, and trust/operating account reconciliation.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Listed as "Get pricing" with no published dollar figure. Adds AI-drafted billing, document-to-calendar conversion, AI client updates, and a client portal on top of Starter.

tiers.name: Signature
tiers.notes: Listed as "Get pricing" with no published dollar figure. Adds unlimited custom roles/permissions, kanban matter stages, AI-generated profitability/productivity reports, and multi-currency billing on top of Core.

tiers.name: Elite
tiers.notes: Listed as "Get pricing" with no published dollar figure. Bundles Clio Manage Signature with Clio Grow's client-intake/CRM suite; Clio advertises this bundle as saving over 17% versus buying separately.

alternatives.name: QuickBooks Online
alternatives.description: Small-business accounting software for invoicing, expense tracking, and basic financial reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Solo practitioners or very small firms that only need basic invoicing and bookkeeping rather than legal-specific matter management and trust accounting.

alternatives.name: DocuSign
alternatives.description: An e-signature and agreement management platform for sending, signing, and tracking documents electronically.
alternatives.best_for: Firms that mainly need e-signature and document execution for engagement letters and agreements rather than full matter management.
strengths: Strong audit trail for signed documents
Integrates into many existing document workflows
